scenario.name: Crypt of Ghouls
scenario.description: Tier 2 5e 2024 (SRD 5.2) undead gauntlet: three Level 5 adventurers (Champion Fighter, Evoker Wizard, Life Cleric) face two Ghouls, a Ghast, and a Skeleton archer, testing AoE Fireball placement, Paralysis threat management, 0-HP revival via Healing Word, Bless concentration, Extra Attack, and Weapon Masteries.

actions.table_talk: Dropping fireball on Crypt Archer, Crypt Ghast, Crypt Ghoul B—allies are clear!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Fireball (DC 15 DEX): Crypt Archer fails and takes 27 fire damage.
Crypt Archer drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
Lyra Starweave casts Fireball (DC 15 DEX): Crypt Ghast fails and takes 27 fire damage.
Crypt Ghast drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
Lyra Starweave casts Fireball (DC 15 DEX): Crypt Ghoul B succeeds and takes 13 fire damage.

Dorian Dawnshield casts Spirit Guardians (DC 15 WIS): Crypt Ghoul B succeeds and takes 18 radiant/necrotic damage.
